title: Batch job retirement: finish or resume without false completion
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Retire an active synthetic batch worker only after finishing or retaining a usable checkpoint; distinguish resumable work, missing or duplicate effects, false completion and unknown proof.
preconditions: A browser supporting standard local HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Six fixed synthetic items, one effect of 10 and 10 synthetic milliseconds per processing attempt.
The old worker has committed items 1-3 before the retirement action.
No account, credentials, subscription, server, framework or real worker.
actions: Choose a retirement action, checkpoint condition, replay policy, observation and bounded timing inputs.
Start the job; retire the active worker; continue or verify the job.
Inspect per-item effects, missing work, duplicates, elapsed time and separate synthetic checks.
Check a learning prediction independently of job impact.
Start another attempt while retaining completed history, or explicitly reset.
assertions: A durable checkpoint at retirement is resumable work, not a completed job.
A replacement completes all six items exactly once within the original budget.
Finishing before retirement does not require a checkpoint.
Stale checkpoint replay is safe only when duplicate effects are prevented.
Local-only checkpoints, forced retirement and false completion retain explicit missing work.
Unobserved effects remain unknown; known failures still dominate partial uncertainty.
Strict input and phase guards cannot mutate locked state or erase history.

iac.decisionStage: Recorded after genuine loadable-stub behavioral RED and before implementation.
iac.reason: Resource-free local synthetic lesson; no cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, deployment, expenditure or production-runtime work is authorized or needed.

limits: All workers, checkpoints, effects, traces and elapsed times are synthetic.
No actual durable storage, host retirement, batch runtime, protocol or Azure result.
No identity, tokens, keys or authentication are needed or modeled.
History is in-memory only, bounded to eight results, and erased by explicit reset or page reload.
B-S048 and original D-S048 native acceptance remain separate and unfulfilled.
One frozen S unit only; tests, evidence and publication earn no extra units.
No shared edits, packages, framework, downloads, cloud resources, real credentials or unsafe browser flags.
The published helper's known unattended lifecycle limitation remains unqualified.
